children: Bilibili's advertising headwinds are priced in, with a stronger games pipeline offering earnings upside, Deutsche Bank analyst Leo Chiang says in a note. Worries that short dramas are luring users away, which have weighed on the stock, appear overstated, Chiang says. Deutsche Bank cuts its target price for the U.S.-listed shares to US$20 from US$32, and for the Hong Kong-listed shares to 160 Hong Kong dollars from HK$250, to factor in slower ad growth and economic uncertainty weighing on long-term cash flow. It maintains a buy rating, saying the stock looks inexpensive at 9x 2027 earnings. The ADRs closed 2.97% higher at US$11.43 on Wednesday, while the Hong Kong-listed shares are unchanged at HK$88.80. (venkat.pr@wsj.com)
